title: Your Right to Ask Riverbend to Amend Your Health Record — Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
Statement of how Riverbend Regional Health decides a request to amend a health record made under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product, and what follows when an amendment is accepted or denied.

## The rule

An amendment request is decided within the request type's action deadline, extendable once. It must state a reason where the request type requires a reason. It may be denied only on the listed amendment denial grounds; on denial the patient may file a statement of disagreement that is appended to the record (where the request type allows a statement of disagreement), and Riverbend may append a rebuttal (where the request type allows a rebuttal). An accepted amendment is made to the record and, where the request type provides for notifying others of an accepted amendment, sent to the persons the patient identifies.

Delivery of the amendment fulfills the request; an amendment denied in whole on a listed ground leaves the request denied.

## The two outcomes

| | Amendment accepted | Amendment denied |
|---|---|---|
| Basis | — | only one of the listed amendment denial grounds |
| Effect on the record | the amendment is made to the record | the patient may file a statement of disagreement, which is appended to the record |
| Riverbend's side | the amendment is sent to the persons the patient identifies | Riverbend may append a rebuttal |

## Points of judgement

- **Time to decide**: the action deadline of the request type, with one extension available.
- **Reason**: required where the request type calls for one.
- **Denial**: never on a ground outside the listed amendment denial grounds.
- **After a denial**: the statement of disagreement is the patient's to file; the rebuttal is Riverbend's to append, and Riverbend may append one.
- **After an acceptance**: the amendment goes into the record and to the persons the patient identifies.

## Illustration (hypothetical request)

A patient files an Amendment of Health Record Request, stating a reason, asking that an allergy entry be corrected. If the request is accepted, the correction is made to the record and sent to the persons the patient identified. If it is denied on one of the listed grounds, the patient may file a statement of disagreement to be appended to the record, and Riverbend may append a rebuttal to it.
